title: Trump, Xi and Putin to gather at APEC summit in Shenzhen as trade truce talks resume
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Wednesday and Thursday, with U.S. officials saying the talks will focus on implementing a trade truce of lower tariffs and some rare-earths flows that was extended by two months, to January 2027. Expectations for any breakthrough are low.
